name: Monopoli – Polignano a Mare (BA), Puglia

source.title: Regione Puglia, Dati monitoraggio Xylella fastidiosa (campaigns 2020-2023)

imagery: Sentinel-2 L2A, Microsoft Planetary Computer; same composites as xylella_scanner.load_season

scanner_params.burned_window: from the start of the baseline summer

columns.id: sample ID in the regional data set
columns.season: scanner season the sample is compared with (calibrate_scanner.sample_season)
columns.positive: 1 if the lab result was positive
columns.row: row of the tree's cell on the region grid
columns.judged: 1 if the scanner's land mask lets it judge this cell
columns.judged3: share of the 3 x 3 window the land mask lets it judge
columns.flag_bits: effective scanner flags of the cell at extraction time (bit k = season 2010 + k)
columns.flag_bits3: the same, OR-ed over the 3 x 3 window
columns.osavi_<year>: median July-August OSAVI of the tree's cell (empty: too few clear dates)
columns.osavi3_<year>: median of the 3 x 3 window's seasonal values
columns.burned_<season>: 1 if MODIS mapped the cell as burned in the scanner's fire window, empty if unknown
